scripts.update: bun run clean && bun run download && bun run generate && bun run build
scripts.clean:svg: set -eu; for w in 100 200 300 400 500 600 700; do bunx @material-design-icons/scripts delete svg --symbols --in svg/$w; done
scripts.download: bun run download:font && bun run download:fonts && bun run download:svg && bun run download:metadata && bun run copy:metadata
scripts.download:fonts: set -eu; for w in 100 200 300 400 500 600 700; do bunx @material-design-icons/scripts download font --symbols --evergreen --weight $w --grade 0 --size 48 --to font/$w; done
scripts.download:svg: set -eu; for w in 100 200 300 400 500 600 700; do bunx @material-design-icons/scripts download svg --symbols --weight $w --to svg/$w; done
scripts.generate: bun run generate:types && bun run copy:types
scripts.copy:types: set -eu; for w in 100 200 300 400 500 600 700; do cp material-symbols/index.d.ts font/$w; done
scripts.build: bun run build:font && bun run build:svg
scripts.version: npm version -w material-symbols -w font/100 -w font/200 -w font/300 -w font/400 -w font/500 -w font/600 -w font/700 -w svg/100 -w svg/200 -w svg/300 -w svg/400 -w svg/500 -w svg/600 -w svg/700 -w metadata
scripts.postversion: bun install && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./material-symbols/package.json').version") bun run git-commit-tag
scripts.publish: bun publish -w material-symbols -w font/100 -w font/200 -w font/300 -w font/400 -w font/500 -w font/600 -w font/700 -w svg/100 -w svg/200 -w svg/300 -w svg/400 -w svg/500 -w svg/600 -w svg/700 -w metadata
